name: ACE Atlas Triaxial Criterion Projection
description: F-C-P projection over ACE Atlas artifacts for criterion discernment. This manifest does not duplicate existing artifacts; it declares how existing and new artifacts are consulted by the Triaxial Method.

architecture.principle: Artifacts provide references; projections provide orientation; triaxial discernment resolves criterion; runtime policy decides action.

foundation.description: Foundation axis. Determines the reference mode of the statement or trajectory.

fictional.role: fictional or explicitly imagined reference mode

hypothetical.role: conditional, possible, counterfactual, or exploratory reference mode

out_of_field.description: Out-of-field is not treated as a normal reference mode in v0.1. It is detected through low margin, high origin cost, weak field fit, or poor foundational preservation.

context.description: Context axis. Determines the relational trajectory or operational frame in which meaning is functioning.

research.role: evidence gathering, comparison, verification, uncertainty, provisional conclusions

training.role: instruction, examples, safe simulation, learner protection, prevention

manipulation.role: pressure, omission, urgency, coercion, selective framing, credential extraction

narrative.role: story, characters, imagined events, symbolic framing, fictional continuity

security.role: cybersecurity, access control, defensive or exploitative security language

credential_request.role: requests involving passwords, PINs, keys, tokens, usernames, credentials, or access codes

evidence_selection.role: selective inclusion, omission, biased evidence handling

urgency_pressure.role: time pressure, fear of loss, coercive urgency

safe_verification.role: independent verification, trusted channels, defensive validation

argumentative_bias.role: preselected conclusion, rhetorical pressure, evidence distortion

principle.description: Principle axis. Determines the orientation or principle being preserved by the trajectory.

investigate.role: discover, verify, compare evidence, preserve uncertainty

protect.role: reduce harm, verify safely, prevent misuse, preserve security

exploit.role: deceive, extract, pressure, bypass consent, obtain unsafe advantage

degrade.role: break structure, increase disorder, undermine orientation

persuade.role: move belief or action through framing or argument

transversal.description: Transversal artifacts are not direct F-C-P labels but support interpretation and drift detection.

rhetorical.role: persuasive framing, emotional pressure, narrative dominance, reinterpretation, rhetorical movement
rhetorical.interpretation_rule: Rhetorical movement is not automatically drift. It becomes a risk signal when combined with low evidence, manipulation, pressure, or exploitative principle.

derived_fields.description: Derived fields are stable operational configurations of Foundation, Context, and Principle.

pre_discernment.description: Before full triaxial discernment, the Atlas checks field fit, origin cost, objective alignment, ambiguity, and risk signals.

triaxial_discernment.description: When ambiguity, drift, risk, or conflict appears, the Triaxial Method resolves criterion by evaluating Foundation, Context, and Principle together.
conflict_examples: high rhetorical movement and low evidence
declared objective = research while context shifts toward manipulation

runtime_policy.description: Runtime policy converts projection signals into operational decisions.

credential_verification.description: Any request involving passwords, PINs, keys, tokens, usernames, credentials, access codes, verification codes, private keys, or secrets requires independent verification.

validation_requirements.goal: Calibrated decision behavior: clear when clear, ambiguous when ambiguous, reorient when drifting, verify when access risk appears, restrict or block when exploitation appears.
